data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"A test constrains rather than describes when the author is the instrument and the acceptance record is the specification; the 3-of-26 result is an artifact of the same author writing both the guard and the mutation in the same week, so the test only confirms the author's model of failure rather than an external distribution.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If a different author's mutations produce a similar loss rate, the constraint claim weakens.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the mutations were generated independently of the acceptance record, the test describes an external distribution.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the 3-of-26 result is stable across multiple weeks and authors, it describes a property of the code.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Same-author-same-week means the mutation generator and the guard author share a failure vocabulary. The test constrains its subject because the subject (mutations) is drawn from the same cognitive source as the test (guards), so the test can only describe what the author already believes is fail-able.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
